integrity: Analytical Descartes/Bernstein proof plus exact rational independent checks; no independent scientific audit or certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem bounds only equilibria of the defector–protector invariant edge of a specified infinite-population replicator model, and does not classify other edges, interior equilibria, basin sizes, or finite-population effects. The model-specific result uses the previously established Bernstein variation theorem and does not claim that proof technique as new. Publication priority outside inspected sources remains uncertain.
title: At most three defector–protector coexistence states, sharply attained at four players
